Bihar floods damage exam papers; officials claim documents are safe

Heavy rainfall in Bihar's Buxar district led to waterlogging, damaging quarterly examination question papers at 167 schools. The state's Education Minister has sought an explanation for the incident. While visuals of soaked papers circulated widely, officials stated that essential documents remain secure.
